observations: Photo 0 shows a white plastic water tank (IBC tote) on a blue metal stand, with another similar tank stacked above it. The stand has a label: 'THERO PEN INC. IBC TANK ELEVATING STAND'.
Photo 1 shows multiple white IBC totes stacked in pairs, with black plastic base and top caps. Some have red and yellow valves visible.
Photo 2 shows a single white IBC tote in a warehouse setting, with a blue valve and red cap on the side. The tank has a metal cage and a gray panel on one side.
All tanks appear to be standard 1000L IBC totes, commonly used for water or chemicals in construction or industrial settings.
The seller's text claims '1000 Litters' (misspelled 'Liters'), which matches the standard size of these tanks.
No visible damage or leaks in any photo, but no interior or bottom view is provided.
